newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends 1.85 higher vs dlr at 1,058.50.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends 1.85 higher vs dlr at 1,058.50.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 15 Reuter - Colombia's peso ended 1.85 pesos higher against the dollar at 1,058.50 in brisk trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.

"We moved a lot more today that yesterday, the exchange rate was moving from one side to the other all day," one dealer said of the trading session, which saw the peso move in a 1,057.45-to- 1,060.90 range.
He and others said dollar sales by exporters were the leading factor contributing to the peso's rise.
Dealers reported 418 trades for a total of $167 million.
